item.title: Rose-Marie Aurora Fleming
item.description: Passed away at Terraceview Lodge in Terrace BC on December 4, 2025. Born August 16, 1941, in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories to August and Johana Mengersen, older sister to brother Ernest. In the mid 1940’s the family moved to Duncan and then Campbell River where Rose-Marie graduated from Carihi High School. She attended the School of Psychiatric Nursing at Essondale Hospital, graduating as a psychiatric nurse in 1960.
